datasets.name: Evolution Marketplace Archive (2014-2015)
datasets.officialSource: Gwern Branwen Darknet Market Archives (2011-2015) / Academic Dumps
datasets.accessMethod: Academic torrent archive and public research mirrored dumps
datasets.modality: Marketplace listings, vendor feedback, price histories, buyer feedback
datasets.limitations: Historical data (2014-2015), single marketplace schema, anonymized transaction amounts
datasets.privacyConcerns: Potential residual PII in unstructured buyer feedback and listing descriptions
datasets.leakageMitigation: Vendor-disjoint splits and temporal cutoff windows

datasets.name: VeriDark Authorship Verification Dataset
datasets.accessMethod: Academic NLP and cyber threat intelligence research repositories
datasets.modality: Forum posts, message threads, author ID pairs
datasets.limitations: English and Cyrillic transliterated text dominance, varying text sample lengths
datasets.privacyConcerns: Scraped darknet forum posts; strict redaction of handle identities during feature extraction
datasets.leakageMitigation: Strict author-level disjoint partitioning (train authors != test authors)

datasets.name: NICT Darknet Dataset 2022
datasets.officialSource: National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT), Japan
datasets.accessMethod: Formal application submitted to NICT Cybersecurity Nexus; requires Institutional NDA
datasets.modality: Telescope darknet passive sensor network traffic
datasets.limitations: Strictly transport-layer network packets; zero application-layer content, zero actor identities
datasets.privacyConcerns: Payload stripped; IP addresses anonymized by NICT prior to distribution
datasets.leakageMitigation: Temporal-window partitioning across distinct sensor subnet ranges

datasets.name: Darknet Surfing Corpus
datasets.officialSource: Academic Tor Web-Crawl Link Topology Initiative
datasets.accessMethod: Direct researcher credential application / institutional repository transfer
datasets.modality: Hidden service HTML bodies, inbound/outbound onion hyperlink graph
datasets.limitations: Static snapshots of dynamic onion services; dead links on deprecated v2 onions
datasets.privacyConcerns: Unfiltered web crawls; risk of containing illicit material requiring hash-only retention
